_comment: Preferred itinerary for the RV trip. References ids defined in assets/map.json — when conditions change, only this file changes; the catalog (map.json) stays put. Eventually this lives in hobby-server's rv DB and gets edited via the UI; for now it's a static file fetched by map-v2.js.
_comment_days: Each day has a `sleep` (an id from map.json's locations[] or junctions[] — typically a kind:'sleep' or kind:'major' location). The renderer infers the route walked that day by finding the previous day's sleep in map.json's route[], walking forward through route entries (including any spurs needed to reach off-route sleeps), and ending at this day's sleep. Day 1 starts at the trip's origin (the first node of map.json's route[]). Optional fields: `notes` (free-form strings), `must_do` (list of activity names — for future use when activities exist as data).
